q: भारत में गुलाम (ममलूक) वंश (1206 ई.) के संस्थापक कौन थे, जिन्हें अपनी उदारता के कारण 'लाख बख्श' कहा जाता था?
e: Qutbuddin Aibak founded the Delhi Sultanate (Slave/Mamluk Dynasty) in 1206 CE with Lahore as his capital and earned the title 'Lakh Baksh'. (कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक ने 1206 ई. में लाहौर को राजधानी बनाकर दिल्ली सल्तनत की नींव रखी और अपनी दानशीलता के कारण 'लाख बख्श' कहलाए।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) He built Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque (Delhi), Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra (Ajmer), and began the construction of Qutub Minar (dedicated to Sufi saint Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki); (2) He died in 1210 CE while playing Chaugan (polo) at Lahore; (3) Hasan Nizami ('Taj-ul-Maasir') and Fakhr-i-Mudabbir were in his court; (4) Iltutmish is regarded as the real founder of the Delhi Sultanate.
qe: Who was the founder of the Slave (Mamluk) Dynasty in India (1206 CE), popularly known as 'Lakh Baksh' (giver of lakhs) for his generosity?

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने चाँदी का 'टंका' तथा ताँबे का 'जीतल' सिक्का चलाया और भारत में 'इक्ता' व्यवस्था को सुव्यवस्थित किया?
e: Shamsuddin Iltutmish (1211–1236 CE) introduced pure Arabic coinage—the silver Tanka (175 grains) and copper Jital—and institutionalized the Iqta land-revenue assignment system. (इल्तुतमिश ने शुद्ध अरबी सिक्के—चाँदी का टंका व ताँबे का जीतल—चलाए और इक्ता व्यवस्था को सुसंगठित किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Iltutmish shifted the capital from Lahore to Delhi and received the Letter of Investiture (Manshur) from the Abbasid Caliph of Baghdad in 1229 CE; (2) He created 'Turkan-i-Chahalgani' (Corps of Forty Turkish nobles); (3) He completed the construction of Qutub Minar; (4) During his reign (1221 CE), Mongol invader Genghis Khan reached the Indus chasing Jalaluddin Mangbarni, and Iltutmish saved Delhi through diplomacy.
qe: Which Delhi Sultan introduced the silver 'Tanka' and copper 'Jital' coins and formally organized the 'Iqta' system in India?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के सिंहासन पर बैठने वाली प्रथम और एकमात्र मुस्लिम महिला शासिका (1236–1240 ई.) कौन थी?
e: Razia Sultan (daughter of Iltutmish) ruled Delhi from 1236 to 1240 CE, discarding purdah and wearing male attire (Quba and Kulah) in open court. (इल्तुतमिश की पुत्री रज़िया सुल्तान 1236 से 1240 ई. तक दिल्ली की शासिका रहीं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) She appointed Jamal-ud-din Yaqut (Abyssinian) as Amir-i-Akhur (Master of the Royal Stables), provoking Turkish nobles; (2) She married Malik Altunia (Governor of Bhatinda) and was killed near Kaithal (Haryana) in October 1240 CE; (3) Chronicler Minhaj-us-Siraj ('Tabaqat-i-Nasiri') praised her royal qualities; (4) Chand Bibi defended Ahmednagar against Akbar's forces.
qe: Who was the first and only woman Muslim ruler to ascend the throne of the Delhi Sultanate (1236–1240 CE)?

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने कठोर 'लौह एवं रक्त की नीति' अपनाई और दरबार में फारसी प्रथाएँ 'सिजदा' तथा 'पाबोस' प्रारंभ कीं?
e: Ghiyasuddin Balban (1266–1287 CE) crushed the 'Chahalgani' (Forty nobles), followed the 'Blood and Iron' policy against rebels and Mewatis, and introduced Sijda (prostration), Paibos (kissing the Sultan's feet), and the Persian festival of Nauroz. (गयासुद्दीन बलबन ने चालीसा दल का दमन कर 'लौह एवं रक्त की नीति' अपनाई और सिजदा, पाबोस व नौरोज़ प्रथाएँ प्रारंभ कीं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Balban propounded the Divine Theory of Kingship, calling himself 'Zil-i-Ilahi' (Shadow of God) and 'Niyabat-i-Khudai' (Deputy of God); (2) He established the separate military department 'Diwan-i-Arz'; (3) His son Prince Muhammad was killed fighting Mongols in 1285 CE; (4) Amir Khusrau began his poetic career under Balban's son Prince Muhammad.
qe: Which Sultan of Delhi adopted the ruthless policy of 'Blood and Iron' (लौह एवं रक्त की नीति) and introduced the Persian court customs of 'Sijda' and 'Paibos'?

q: कौन-सा दिल्ली सुल्तान कठोर बाजार नियंत्रण (मूल्य नियमन) प्रणाली, 'दाग' (घोड़ों को दागना) और 'हुलिया/चेहरा' प्रथा लागू करने के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Alauddin Khilji (1296–1316 CE) maintained a large standing army paid in cash and introduced strict market regulations (Shahna-i-Mandi, Diwan-i-Riyasat), Dagh, and Chehra to curb corruption and fund defence against Mongols. (अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने विशाल स्थायी सेना को नकद वेतन देने हेतु बाजार नियंत्रण प्रणाली, दाग और हुलिया प्रथा लागू की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) He established 'Diwan-i-Mustakhraj' to collect revenue arrears and measured land ('Biswa' as unit), charging 50% Kharaj plus Ghari (house tax) and Charai (grazing tax); (2) His general Malik Kafur ('Hazar Dinari') led victorious Deccan campaigns against Devagiri, Warangal, Dwarasamudra, and Madurai; (3) He built Alai Darwaza, Siri Fort, and Hauz Khas; (4) He assumed the title 'Sikandar-i-Sani' (Second Alexander).
qe: Which Delhi Sultan is famous for implementing strict Market Control (Price Regulation) reforms, 'Dagh' (branding of horses), and 'Huliya/Chehra' (descriptive roll of soldiers)?

q: 1347 ई. में दक्कन में गुलबर्गा (अहसानाबाद) को राजधानी बनाकर बहमनी साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Zafar Khan (Hasan Gangu) revolted against Muhammad bin Tughlaq in 1347 CE and founded the Bahmani Kingdom under the title Alauddin Bahman Shah with Gulbarga as capital. (1347 ई. में हसन गंगू (जफर खाँ) ने मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक के विरुद्ध विद्रोह कर गुलबर्गा को राजधानी बनाकर बहमनी राज्य की स्थापना की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Ahmad Shah I later shifted the Bahmani capital from Gulbarga to Bidar (1425 CE); (2) Mahmud Gawan was the great Prime Minister (Wazir) of Bahmani Kingdom who built the famous Bidar Madrasa; (3) Later Bahmani split into 5 Deccan Sultanates: Bijapur (Adil Shahi), Golconda (Qutb Shahi), Ahmednagar (Nizam Shahi), Bidar (Barid Shahi), and Berar (Imad Shahi); (4) Vijayanagara Empire was founded earlier in 1336 CE by Harihara I and Bukka I.
qe: Who founded the Bahmani Kingdom in the Deccan in 1347 CE with Gulbarga (Ahsanabad) as its capital?

q: किस लोदी सुल्तान ने 1504 ई. में आगरा नगर की स्थापना की और 1506 ई. में उसे अपनी राजधानी बनाया?
e: Sikandar Lodi (1489–1517 CE), the greatest ruler of the Afghan Lodi Dynasty, founded Agra in 1504 CE to control Rajput chiefs and eastern territories, and made it his capital in 1506 CE. (अफगान लोदी वंश के सर्वश्रेष्ठ शासक सिकंदर लोदी ने 1504 ई. में आगरा की स्थापना की और 1506 ई. में उसे राजधानी बनाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Sikandar Lodi introduced the standard land measurement unit 'Gaj-i-Sikandari' (30 inches / 39 digits); (2) He wrote Persian poetry under the pen name 'Gulrukhi'; (3) Bahlul Lodi founded the Lodi Dynasty (1451 CE — first Afghan dynasty of Delhi); (4) Ibrahim Lodi was defeated and killed by Babur in the First Battle of Panipat (21 April 1526).
qe: Which Lodi Sultan founded the city of Agra in 1504 CE and made it his capital in 1506 CE?

q: मध्य एशियाई आक्रमणकारी तैमूर लंग ने नासिरुद्दीन महमूद तुगलक के शासनकाल में किस वर्ष भारत पर आक्रमण कर दिल्ली को लूटा?
e: Timur invaded India in December 1398 CE during the reign of the last Tughlaq ruler Nasiruddin Mahmud, devastating Delhi and fatally weakening the Tughlaq dynasty. (तैमूर लंग ने 1398 ई. में अंतिम तुगलक शासक नासिरुद्दीन महमूद के समय भारत पर आक्रमण कर दिल्ली को लूटा।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Before departing, Timur appointed Khizr Khan as governor of Multan, Lahore, and Dipalpur; (2) Khizr Khan later founded the Sayyid Dynasty in 1414 CE (assuming the title 'Rayat-i-Ala' instead of Sultan); (3) Yahya bin Ahmad Sirhindi wrote 'Tarikh-i-Mubarakshahi' during the Sayyid period; (4) Babur traced his paternal lineage to Timur and maternal lineage to Genghis Khan.
qe: In which year did the Central Asian conqueror Timur (Tamerlane) invade India and sack Delhi during the reign of Nasiruddin Mahmud Tughlaq?

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने कृषि विभाग 'दीवान-ए-कोही' की स्थापना की और 1329–30 ई. में सांकेतिक ताँबे/काँसे की मुद्रा चलाई?
e: Muhammad bin Tughlaq (Jauna Khan, 1325–1351 CE) set up 'Diwan-i-Amir-i-Kohi' to expand cultivation via Sondhar/Takkavi agricultural loans and launched token currency alongside four other ambitious projects. (मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने कृषि सुधार हेतु 'दीवान-ए-कोही' की स्थापना की और सांकेतिक मुद्रा प्रचलित की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) His five famous projects: Taxation in Doab, Transfer of Capital from Delhi to Daulatabad (Devagiri), Token Currency, Khurasan Expedition, and Qarachil Expedition; (2) Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta ('Rihla') visited India in 1333 CE and was appointed Qazi of Delhi by him; (3) On his death in Thatta (1351), Badauni wrote: "The king was freed from his people and they from their king"; (4) He was the first Delhi Sultan to participate in Hindu festivals like Holi.
qe: Which Delhi Sultan established the 'Diwan-i-Kohi' (Department of Agriculture) and introduced token copper/bronze currency (1329–30 CE)?

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने 'दीवान-ए-खैरात' (दान विभाग), 'दीवान-ए-बंदगान' (दास विभाग) और 'दार-उल-शफा' (निःशुल्क अस्पताल) की स्थापना की तथा ब्राह्मणों पर भी पृथक् जज़िया कर लगाया?
e: Firoz Shah Tughlaq (1351–1388 CE) created Diwan-i-Khairat, Diwan-i-Bandagan (managing ~1.8 lakh slaves), Dar-ul-Shifa, an Employment Bureau, and levied 4 Shariat taxes (Kharaj, Khums, Zakat, Jizya — extending Jizya to Brahmins) plus 'Haq-i-Sharb' (10% irrigation tax). (फिरोज शाह तुगलक ने दीवान-ए-खैरात, दीवान-ए-बंदगान, दार-उल-शफा बनवाए तथा ब्राह्मणों पर भी जज़िया कर लगाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) He founded cities like Jaunpur (in memory of Jauna Khan), Firozabad, Hisar, Fatehabad, and Firozpur; (2) He transported two Ashokan pillars from Topra (Haryana) and Meerut to Delhi; (3) He wrote his autobiography 'Futuhat-i-Firozshahi'; (4) He abolished 24 non-Shariat cesses and made Iqta hereditary.
qe: Which Delhi Sultan established 'Diwan-i-Khairat' (charity bureau), 'Diwan-i-Bandagan' (department of slaves), and 'Dar-ul-Shifa' (free hospital), and imposed Jizya separately on Brahmins?

q: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी की बाजार नियंत्रण प्रणाली में अनाज मंडी में निर्धारित मूल्यों की निगरानी और प्रवर्तन हेतु नियुक्त मुख्य अधिकारी को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Alauddin Khilji appointed Malik Qabul as 'Shahna-i-Mandi' (Superintendent of the Market) under the overall department 'Diwan-i-Riyasat' (headed by Malik Yaqub) to maintain strict price control. (अलाउद्दीन ने बाजार नियंत्रण हेतु 'दीवान-ए-रियासत' विभाग तथा मंडी अधीक्षक के रूप में 'शहना-ए-मंडी' (मलिक कबूल) की नियुक्ति की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Three main markets were established in Delhi: Grain Market (Mandi), Cloth/Luxury Market (Sarai-i-Adl), and Horse/Slave/Cattle Market; (2) 'Barids' (intelligence officers) and 'Munhiyans' (secret spies) reported market violations directly to the Sultan; (3) Ziauddin Barani's 'Tarikh-i-Firozshahi' is the primary source on Alauddin's market reforms; (4) 'Ariz-i-Mumalik' headed the military department (Diwan-i-Arz).
qe: Under Alauddin Khilji's Market Control system, what was the designation of the chief officer appointed to supervise and enforce fixed prices in the grain market (Mandi)?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस प्रथम सुल्तान ने सिंचाई हेतु नहरों का निर्माण कराया और तुगलकाबाद नामक दुर्ग-नगर बसाया?
e: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq (Ghazi Malik, 1320–1325 CE), founder of the Tughlaq dynasty, was the first Sultan to dig canals for irrigation and built the fortress city of Tughlaqabad near Delhi. (तुगलक वंश के संस्थापक गयासुद्दीन तुगलक सिंचाई हेतु नहरें बनवाने वाले प्रथम सुल्तान थे और उन्होंने तुगलकाबाद बसाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Firoz Shah Tughlaq later built the largest network of canals (e.g., Yamuna to Hisar, Sutlej to Ghaggar); (2) Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq had strained relations with Sufi saint Nizamuddin Auliya, who famously remarked "Hunuz Dilli Dur Ast" (Delhi is still far away); (3) He died in 1325 CE when a wooden pavilion collapsed at Afghanpur near Delhi; (4) He perfected the postal (Dak) system using horse and foot runners.
qe: Who was the first Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate to construct irrigation canals and build the fortified city of Tughlaqabad?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस दरबारी कवि को 'तूती-ए-हिन्द' (हिन्द का तोता) कहा जाता है, जिन्होंने बलबन से गयासुद्दीन तुगलक तक सात से अधिक सुल्तानों का शासनकाल देखा?
e: Amir Khusrau (1253–1325 CE, born at Patiyali in Kasganj, UP) was a disciple of Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya and served Sultans from Balban to Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq. (कासगंज के पटियाली में जन्मे अमीर खुसरो हज़रत निज़ामुद्दीन औलिया के शिष्य थे और उन्हें 'तूती-ए-हिन्द' कहा जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) His major works include 'Khazain-ul-Futuh' (Alauddin's conquests), 'Tughlaqnama', 'Nuh Sipihr', 'Ashika', and 'Qiran-us-Sadain'; (2) He pioneered the 'Sabaq-i-Hindi' style of Persian poetry and early Hindavi (Khari Boli); (3) He is credited with popularizing Qawwali, Khayal, Sitar, and Tabla; (4) Ziauddin Barani wrote 'Tarikh-i-Firozshahi' and 'Fatwa-i-Jahandari'.
qe: Which Delhi Sultanate court poet, popularly called 'Tuti-e-Hind' (Parrot of India), witnessed the reigns of seven (or eight) Delhi Sultans from Balban to Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के केंद्रीय प्रशासन में 'दीवान-ए-इंशा' विभाग किस कार्य के लिए उत्तरदायी था?
e: 'Diwan-i-Insha' (headed by Dabir-i-Khas) handled royal correspondence, drafting of firmans, and diplomatic dispatches. (दीवान-ए-इंशा शाही पत्राचार और राजकीय फरमानों के प्रारूपण का विभाग था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The four core ministries of the Sultanate were: Diwan-i-Wizarat (Finance/Wazir), Diwan-i-Arz (Military/Ariz-i-Mumalik), Diwan-i-Insha (Correspondence/Dabir-i-Khas), and Diwan-i-Risalat (Religious/Foreign Affairs/Sadr-us-Sudur); (2) 'Qazi-ul-Quzat' was the Chief Justice; (3) 'Muhtasib' supervised public morals and market weights; (4) 'Amil' collected revenue at the Pargana level.
qe: In the central administration of the Delhi Sultanate, the department 'Diwan-i-Insha' was responsible for:

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के सैय्यद वंश (1414–1451 ई.) के संस्थापक कौन थे, जिन्होंने तैमूर के प्रतिनिधि के रूप में 'रैयत-ए-आला' की उपाधि धारण कर शासन किया?
e: Khizr Khan (1414–1421 CE) founded the Sayyid Dynasty after the collapse of the Tughlaqs, avoiding the title 'Sultan' and styling himself 'Rayat-i-Ala' (Vassal of Timur and Shah Rukh). (खिज्र खाँ ने 1414 ई. में सैय्यद वंश की स्थापना की और 'सुल्तान' के स्थान पर 'रैयत-ए-आला' की उपाधि धारण की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The Sayyid Dynasty had four rulers: Khizr Khan, Mubarak Shah, Muhammad Shah, and Alauddin Alam Shah; (2) Mubarak Shah founded Mubarakabad on the Yamuna and patronized historian Yahya bin Ahmad Sirhindi; (3) Alauddin Alam Shah voluntarily abdicated in 1451 CE in favour of Bahlul Lodi and retired to Badaun; (4) The five dynasties of Delhi Sultanate in order: Slave (1206–90), Khilji (1290–1320), Tughlaq (1320–1414), Sayyid (1414–51), Lodi (1451–1526).
qe: Who was the founder of the Sayyid Dynasty (1414–1451 CE) of the Delhi Sultanate, who ruled as Timur's nominee under the title 'Rayat-i-Ala'?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के पाँच राजवंशों में से किस राजवंश ने सर्वाधिक लंबी अवधि (94 वर्ष, 1320–1414 ई.) तक शासन किया?
e: The Tughlaq Dynasty ruled for 94 years (1320–1414 CE)—the longest among the five Sultanate dynasties—whereas the Khilji Dynasty ruled for the shortest duration (30 years, 1290–1320 CE). (तुगलक वंश ने सर्वाधिक 94 वर्ष तथा खिलजी वंश ने सबसे कम 30 वर्ष तक दिल्ली सल्तनत पर शासन किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Durations: Slave (84 yrs), Khilji (30 yrs), Tughlaq (94 yrs), Sayyid (37 yrs), Lodi (75 yrs); (2) Among individual Sultans, Bahlul Lodi had the longest reign (38 years, 1451–1489 CE), followed by Firoz Shah Tughlaq (37 years, 1351–1388 CE); (3) Alauddin Khilji expanded the Sultanate's reach to the far south, while under Muhammad bin Tughlaq it reached its maximum territorial extent (23 provinces).
qe: Which Sultan of Delhi had the LONGEST reign (94 years for his dynasty, 1320–1414 CE, being the longest-ruling dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate)?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत की इक्ता प्रणाली में इक्तादार (मुक्ति) द्वारा सेना व प्रशासनिक व्यय निकालने के बाद केंद्रीय राजकोष में जमा की जाने वाली अधिशेष राशि को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: 'Fawazil' was the excess/surplus revenue remitted by the Muqti (Iqtadar) to the Sultan's exchequer after deducting his sanctioned personal salary and military maintenance costs. (इक्ता से प्राप्त आय में से वेतन व सैन्य व्यय घटाकर राजकोष में जमा की जाने वाली अतिरिक्त राशि 'फवाज़िल' कहलाती थी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) 'Khums' was 1/5th of war booty (Alauddin Khilji reversed it to keep 4/5th for the State and give 1/5th to soldiers); (2) 'Ushr' was land tax on Muslim landowners (5%–10%), while 'Kharaj' was land tax on non-Muslims; (3) Balban appointed 'Khwaja' (accountant) in each Iqta to check Fawazil; (4) Firoz Shah Tughlaq made Iqtas hereditary.
qe: In the Iqta system of the Delhi Sultanate, what was the surplus revenue that an Iqtadar (Muqti) had to remit to the central royal treasury after meeting his troop and administrative expenses?

q: किस बहमनी वज़ीर (प्रधानमंत्री) ने बहमनी साम्राज्य को 8 प्रांतों (तरफों) में विभाजित किया, भूमि मापन की प्रणाली लागू की तथा बीदर में भव्य तीन-मंजिला मदरसा बनवाया?
e: Mahmud Gawan (served 1463–1481 CE under Muhammad Shah III) was an Iranian merchant-turned-statesman who reformed Bahmani administration into 8 Tarafs and built the iconic Bidar Madrasa before being unjustly executed in 1481 CE. (महमूद गवाँ ने बहमनी साम्राज्य को 8 तरफों में बाँटा और बीदर में प्रसिद्ध मदरसा बनवाया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) He captured Goa and Dabhol from Vijayanagara, boosting maritime trade; (2) His execution triggered the rapid disintegration of the Bahmani Kingdom into 5 Deccan Sultanates; (3) Russian traveller Afanasy Nikitin visited the Bahmani Kingdom during his era; (4) Gol Gumbaz (Bijapur) was built later by Muhammad Adil Shah.
qe: Which Bahmani Prime Minister (Wazir) divided the Bahmani Empire into 8 provinces (Tarafs), introduced systematic land revenue measurement, and built a magnificent three-storey Madrasa at Bidar?

q:
ज़ियाउद्दीन बरनी के विवरण के अनुसार मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक की निम्नलिखित योजनाओं को सही कालानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
1. सांकेतिक मुद्रा का प्रचलन
2. दौलताबाद को राजधानी परिवर्तन
3. गंगा-यमुना दोआब में कर-वृद्धि
4. कराचिल अभियान
e: According to Ziauddin Barani, the sequence was: Taxation in Doab (1326–27) → Transfer of Capital to Daulatabad (1327–28) → Token Currency (1329–30) → Khurasan plan & Qarachil Expedition (1332–33 / 1337–38). Hence 3, 2, 1, 4. (बरनी के अनुसार क्रम: दोआब में कर-वृद्धि → राजधानी परिवर्तन → सांकेतिक मुद्रा → कराचिल अभियान, अतः 3, 2, 1, 4।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Token currency failed primarily due to lack of state monopoly over minting, leading to widespread counterfeiting; (2) Qarachil expedition was aimed at the Kumaon-Garhwal Himalayan foothills; (3) Despite failures, historians recognize his progressive vision and religious tolerance (appointing Hindus like Ratan and Kishan Bazran Indri to high posts).
qe:
Arrange the following five famous projects of Muhammad bin Tughlaq in their generally accepted chronological sequence (as per Ziauddin Barani):
1. Token Currency
2. Transfer of Capital to Daulatabad
3. Taxation in the Ganga-Yamuna Doab
4. Qarachil Expedition

q:
सूची-I (दिल्ली सल्तनत विभाग) को सूची-II (संस्थापक सुल्तान) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) दीवान-ए-अर्ज़, (2) दीवान-ए-मुस्तखराज, (3) दीवान-ए-कोही, (4) दीवान-ए-बंदगान
सूची-II: (a) मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक, (b) फिरोज शाह तुगलक, (c) गयासुद्दीन बलबन, (d) अलाउद्दीन खिलजी
e: Diwan-i-Arz (Military) — Balban (1-c); Diwan-i-Mustakhraj (Revenue Arrears) — Alauddin Khilji (2-d); Diwan-i-Kohi (Agriculture) — Muhammad bin Tughlaq (3-a); Diwan-i-Bandagan (Slaves) — Firoz Shah Tughlaq (4-b). (दीवान-ए-अर्ज़-बलबन, मुस्तखराज-अलाउद्दीन, कोही-मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक, बंदगान-फिरोज शाह तुगलक; अतः 1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Diwan-i-Waquf (expenditure audit) was created by Jalaluddin Khilji; (2) Diwan-i-Riyasat (market control) was created by Alauddin Khilji; (3) Diwan-i-Istihqaq (pensions) was created by Firoz Shah Tughlaq.
qe:
Match List-I (Delhi Sultanate Department) with List-II (Founder Sultan) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) Diwan-i-Arz, (2) Diwan-i-Mustakhraj, (3) Diwan-i-Kohi, (4) Diwan-i-Bandagan
List-II: (a) Muhammad bin Tughlaq, (b) Firoz Shah Tughlaq, (c) Ghiyasuddin Balban, (d) Alauddin Khilji

q:
अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के कृषि एवं भू-राजस्व सुधारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: वे वास्तविक भूमि मापन ('मसाहत') के आधार पर भू-राजस्व निर्धारित करने वाले प्रथम दिल्ली सुल्तान थे।
कथन II: उन्होंने ग्रामीण मध्यस्थों (खूत, मुकद्दम और चौधरी) के विशेषाधिकार समाप्त कर उन्हें सामान्य किसानों की भाँति कर देने हेतु बाध्य किया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: कथन I और कथन II दोनों
न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
e: Both statements are correct. Alauddin Khilji pioneered 'Masahat' (measurement using Biswa), converted large areas in the Doab into 'Khalisa' (crown land), and stripped Khuts, Muqaddams, and Chaudharis of their tax-free privileges (Haq-i-Khuti). (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं; अलाउद्दीन ने मसाहत प्रणाली लागू की और खूत, मुकद्दम व चौधरी के विशेषाधिकार समाप्त किए।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Later Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq partially restored the privileges of Khuts and Muqaddams and replaced Masahat with 'Hukm-i-Hasil' (crop-sharing); (2) Alauddin also confiscated religious/charitable grants (Inam, Waqf, Milk) to expand Khalisa land.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Alauddin Khilji's agrarian and revenue reforms:
Statement I: He was the first Delhi Sultan to fix land revenue based on actual measurement of cultivated land ('Masahat').
Statement II: He abolished the traditional privileges of rural intermediaries (Khuts, Muqaddams, and Chaudharis) and compelled them to pay taxes like ordinary peasants.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युद्ध और उसका वर्ष सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: खातोली का युद्ध (इब्राहिम लोदी बनाम राणा साँगा) — 1517–18 ई.
अलाउद्दीन खिलजी द्वारा चित्तौड़ विजय — 1311 ई.
e: Alauddin Khilji conquered Chittor (defeating Rawal Ratan Singh) in 1303 CE (NOT 1311 CE) and renamed it 'Khizrabad' after his son Khizr Khan. All other three pairs are correctly matched. (अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने 1303 ई. में चित्तौड़ जीता था (न कि 1311 ई. में) और उसका नाम खिज्राबाद रखा।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Alauddin's Rajput conquests: Gujarat (1299), Ranthambore (1301), Chittor (1303), Malwa (1305), Siwana (1308), Jalore (1311); (2) In Battle of Chandawar (1194), Muhammad Ghori defeated Jaichand of Kannauj; (3) In Battle of Khatoli (1517–18), Rana Sanga defeated Ibrahim Lodi.
qe: Which of the following battles and years is NOT correctly matched?
oe: Battle of Khatoli (Ibrahim Lodi vs. Rana Sanga) — 1517–18 CE
Conquest of Chittor by Alauddin Khilji — 1311 CE

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस इतिहासकार ने सुल्तान नासिरुद्दीन महमूद को समर्पित 'तबकात-ए-नासिरी' की रचना की और दिल्ली के मुख्य काज़ी के पद पर कार्य किया?
e: Minhaj-us-Siraj Juzjani authored 'Tabaqat-i-Nasiri' (completed 1260 CE), our primary source for the early Mamluk Sultans including Iltutmish and Razia. (मिन्हाज-उस-सिराज ने 'तबकात-ए-नासिरी' की रचना की, जो प्रारंभिक गुलाम वंश का प्रमुख स्रोत है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Shams-i-Siraj Afif wrote 'Tarikh-i-Firozshahi' (exclusively on Firoz Shah Tughlaq); (2) Isami wrote 'Futuh-us-Salatin' in the Bahmani court (critiquing Muhammad bin Tughlaq); (3) Hasan Nizami wrote 'Taj-ul-Maasir' (first official history of the Delhi Sultanate).
qe: Which chronicler of the Delhi Sultanate authored 'Tabaqat-i-Nasiri' (dedicated to Sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud) and served as Chief Qazi of Delhi?

q: सल्तनतकालीन स्थापत्य में अलाउद्दीन खिलजी द्वारा कुतुब परिसर में निर्मित 'अलाई दरवाज़ा' (1311 ई.) भारत में किस वास्तुशिल्पीय विशेषता के प्राचीनतम जीवित उदाहरण के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
o: वैज्ञानिक विधि से निर्मित सच्चा गुंबद एवं घोड़े की नाल के आकार का मेहराब
e: Built in red sandstone and white marble in 1311 CE, Alai Darwaza is hailed as a gem of Indo-Islamic architecture for its earliest perfected true dome and horseshoe arch ('Lotus bud' fringe). (1311 ई. में निर्मित अलाई दरवाज़ा वैज्ञानिक विधि से बने सच्चे गुंबद और अश्वनाल मेहराब के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) First true arch in India appeared earlier in Balban's Tomb (Mehrauli); (2) Double Dome (दोहरा गुंबद) first appeared in Sikandar Lodi's Tomb (1517 CE); (3) Sloping battered walls ('Salami') were the hallmark of Tughlaq architecture; (4) Pietra Dura reached its zenith under Shah Jahan (Taj Mahal, Itmad-ud-Daulah under Nur Jahan).
qe: In the Sultanate architectural style, the 'Alai Darwaza' (1311 CE) built by Alauddin Khilji at the Qutub complex is famous for being the earliest surviving monument in India featuring:
oe: True scientific dome and horseshoe-shaped true arch

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने सर्वप्रथम स्पष्ट घोषणा की कि "राजत्व कोई बंधुत्व नहीं जानता" और राजनीति को कट्टरपंथी उलेमा के नियंत्रण से अलग रखा?
e: Alauddin Khilji explicitly told Qazi Mughisuddin of Bayana that he issued orders based on the welfare of the State and exigencies of the time, independent of Ulema interference, asserting "Kingship knows no kinship." (अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने बयाना के काज़ी मुगीसुद्दीन से स्पष्ट कहा कि वे राज्यहित के अनुसार शासन करते हैं और राजनीति को उलेमा के प्रभाव से मुक्त रखा।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Muhammad bin Tughlaq also kept administration independent of the Ulema; (2) In contrast, Firoz Shah Tughlaq heavily appeased the orthodox Ulema to secure his throne.
qe: Which Sultan of Delhi was the first to officially declare that "Kingship knows no kinship" and separated politics from the control of the orthodox Ulema?

q: ज़हीरुद्दीन मुहम्मद बाबर ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध आत्मकथा 'तुज़ुक-ए-बाबरी' (बाबरनामा) किस भाषा में लिखी थी?
e: Babur wrote 'Tuzuk-i-Baburi' in his native Chagatai Turkish; it was later translated into Persian ('Baburnama') by Abdur Rahim Khan-i-Khana during Akbar's reign. (बाबर ने अपनी आत्मकथा चगताई तुर्की में लिखी थी, जिसका फारसी अनुवाद अकबर के काल में अब्दुर्रहीम खानखाना ने किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Babur's four major battles in India: Panipat I (1526, Ibrahim Lodi), Khanwa (1527, Rana Sanga — assumed title 'Ghazi'), Chanderi (1528, Medini Rai), and Ghaghra (1529, Afghans); (2) Babur introduced the 'Tulughma' battle tactic and 'Osmani' (Rumi) artillery method in India; (3) Only two Mughal emperors wrote their own autobiographies: Babur (Turkish) and Jahangir ('Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri', Persian).
qe: In which language did Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur write his famous autobiography 'Tuzuk-i-Baburi' (Baburnama)?

q: 1540 ई. के किस निर्णायक युद्ध में शेरशाह सूरी से पराजित होने के बाद मुगल सम्राट हुमायूँ को 15 वर्षों के लिए भारत से निर्वासित होना पड़ा?
e: Sher Shah Suri defeated Humayun first at Chausa (1539 CE) and decisively at the Battle of Bilgram/Kannauj (May 1540 CE), establishing the Sur Empire. (शेरशाह सूरी ने 1539 में चौसा और 1540 में बिलग्राम (कन्नौज) के युद्ध में हुमायूँ को निर्णायक रूप से पराजित किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Humayun regained Delhi in July 1555 after defeating Sikandar Shah Suri at the Battle of Sirhind (1555); (2) Humayun died in January 1556 after falling down the stairs of his library 'Sher Mandal' (Dinpanah, Delhi); (3) His sister Gulbadan Begum wrote 'Humayun-nama'; (4) Sher Shah introduced the silver 'Rupiya' (178 grains), Grand Trunk Road (Sadak-i-Azam), and Patta-Qabuliyat land revenue system.
qe: Which decisive battle of 1540 CE forced Mughal Emperor Humayun to flee India into 15 years of exile after being defeated by Sher Shah Suri?

q: सम्राट अकबर ने अपने राजस्व मंत्री राजा टोडरमल द्वारा तैयार 'दहसाला' (ज़ब्ती) भू-राजस्व प्रणाली किस वर्ष लागू की?
e: In 1580 CE, Raja Todar Mal implemented the 'Ain-i-Dahsala' (10-year average yield and price assessment), fixing the State's share at one-third (1/3) of the average produce, payable in cash. (1580 ई. में राजा टोडरमल ने 'आइन-ए-दहसाला' प्रणाली लागू की, जिसमें पिछले 10 वर्षों की औसत उपज का एक-तिहाई भाग भू-राजस्व तय किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Under Todar Mal, land was classified into 4 categories: Polaj (cultivated annually), Parauti (left fallow 1–2 yrs), Chachar (3–4 yrs), and Banjar (5+ yrs); (2) Akbar replaced the Sikandari Gaj with 'Ilahi Gaj' (41 digits); (3) Other key Akbar years: Jizya abolished (1564), Ibadat Khana (1575), Mahzar (1579), Din-i-Ilahi (1582); (4) Raja Birbal (Mahesh Das) was the only Hindu to accept Din-i-Ilahi.
qe: In which year did Emperor Akbar introduce the 'Dahsala' (Zabti) land revenue system formulated by his Revenue Minister Raja Todar Mal?

q: मेवाड़ के महाराणा प्रताप और राजा मानसिंह के नेतृत्व वाली अकबर की मुगल सेना के बीच ऐतिहासिक हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध किस तिथि को लड़ा गया था?
e: The Battle of Haldighati (Rajsamand, Rajasthan) was fought on 18 June 1576 between Maharana Pratap (supported by Hakim Khan Sur and Bhil chief Rana Punja) and Akbar's forces led by Man Singh and Asaf Khan. (हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध 18 जून 1576 को महाराणा प्रताप और मानसिंह के नेतृत्व वाली मुगल सेना के बीच लड़ा गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Maharana Pratap later made Chavand his capital (1585) and recovered most of Mewar (except Chittor and Mandalgarh) after the Battle of Dewair (1582); (2) Historian Abdul Qadir Badauni was an eyewitness to Haldighati; (3) Pratap's loyal horse was Chetak, and Jhala Manna (Bida) wore the royal insignia to save Pratap; (4) Colonel James Tod called Haldighati the 'Thermopylae of Mewar' and Dewair the 'Marathon of Mewar'.
qe: On which date was the historic Battle of Haldighati fought between Maharana Pratap of Mewar and Akbar's Mughal army led by Raja Man Singh?

q: किस मुगल सम्राट के शासनकाल को सर्वसम्मति से 'मुगल स्थापत्य कला का स्वर्ण युग' (ताजमहल, लाल किला, जामा मस्जिद) कहा जाता है?
e: Shah Jahan (1628–1658 CE) ushered in the Golden Age of Mughal Architecture, marked by white Makrana marble, Pietra Dura inlay, and symmetrical elegance (Taj Mahal, Shahjahanabad/Red Fort, Jama Masjid Delhi, Moti Masjid Agra, Peacock Throne). (शाहजहाँ का शासनकाल (1628–1658 ई.) मुगल स्थापत्य कला का स्वर्ण युग कहलाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Jahangir's reign (1605–1627 CE) is called the 'Golden Age of Mughal Painting' (Ustad Mansur, Abul Hasan, Bishandas); (2) Chief architect of Taj Mahal was Ustad Ahmad Lahori; (3) Shah Jahan shifted the Mughal capital from Agra to Shahjahanabad (Delhi) in 1638–48; (4) Dara Shikoh (Shah Jahan's eldest son) translated 52 Upanishads into Persian as 'Sirr-i-Akbar'.
qe: Which Mughal Emperor's reign is universally acclaimed as the 'Golden Age of Mughal Architecture' (Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Jama Masjid)?

q: जून 1674 ई. में वाराणसी के पंडित गागा भट्ट द्वारा छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज का विधिवत् राज्याभिषेक किस दुर्ग में संपन्न हुआ था?
e: Shivaji's formal coronation took place on 6 June 1674 at Raigad Fort (his capital), officiated by Pandit Vishweshwar (Gaga Bhatt) of Kashi, where Shivaji assumed the titles 'Chhatrapati', 'Haindava Dharmoddharak', and 'Go-Brahman Pratipalak'. (6 जून 1674 को रायगढ़ दुर्ग में काशी के पंडित गागा भट्ट ने शिवाजी का राज्याभिषेक किया और उन्होंने 'छत्रपति' की उपाधि धारण की।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) English envoy Henry Oxinden attended Shivaji's coronation; (2) Shivaji was born at Shivneri Fort (Pune) in 1627/1630 CE (Father: Shahji Bhonsle, Mother: Jijabai, Political Guru: Dadaji Kondadev, Spiritual Guru: Samarth Ramdas); (3) Treaty of Purandar (1665) was signed between Shivaji and Mirza Raja Jai Singh (Aurangzeb's general); (4) Shivaji died in April 1680 at Raigad.
qe: At which fort was Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj formally coronated as 'Chhatrapati' in June 1674 by Pandit Gaga Bhatt of Varanasi?

q: किस मुगल सम्राट ने 'आलमगीर' की उपाधि धारण की थी और अपने सादगीपूर्ण व्यक्तिगत जीवन के कारण 'ज़िंदा पीर' कहलाता था?
e: Aurangzeb (1658–1707 CE) ruled under the title 'Alamgir' and was called 'Zinda Pir'; he re-imposed Jizya in 1679 CE, banned court music, and annexed Bijapur (1686) and Golconda (1687). (औरंगजेब ने 'आलमगीर' की उपाधि धारण की और 'ज़िंदा पीर' कहलाया; उसने 1679 में पुनः जज़िया लगाया तथा बीजापुर व गोलकुंडा का विलय किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Ironically, Aurangzeb himself was an accomplished Veena player and the highest number of Persian books on Indian classical music were written during his reign; (2) The percentage of Hindu Mansabdars was actually HIGHEST (~33%) during Aurangzeb's reign; (3) He built Bibi ka Maqbara (Aurangabad) and Moti Masjid inside Delhi's Red Fort; (4) He died in 1707 CE at Ahmednagar and is buried at Khuldabad.
qe: Which Mughal Emperor assumed the title 'Alamgir' (World Conqueror) and was also called 'Zinda Pir' (Living Saint) for his austere personal life?

q: सम्राट अकबर की 'मनसबदारी' प्रणाली में दो संख्यात्मक पद 'जात' (Zat) और 'सवार' (Sawar) क्रमशः क्या दर्शाते थे?
o: मनसबदार का व्यक्तिगत पद/वेतन तथा उसके द्वारा रखे जाने वाले घुड़सवारों की संख्या
जागीर भूमि का क्षेत्रफल तथा वार्षिक नकद कर
हाथियों की संख्या तथा पैदल सैनिकों की संख्या
न्यायिक पद तथा प्रांतीय राजस्व पद
e: Introduced by Akbar around 1571–75 (dual Zat-Sawar rank formalized in 1595–96), 'Zat' determined the Mansabdar's personal rank in the hierarchy and personal salary, while 'Sawar' fixed the number of cavalry troopers (horsemen) he was required to maintain. ('जात' मनसबदार के व्यक्तिगत पद व वेतन को तथा 'सवार' उसके अधीन घुड़सवारों की संख्या को दर्शाता था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Mansabdari was borrowed from the Mongol decimal system (Genghis Khan); (2) Jahangir introduced 'Du-Aspah Sih-Aspah' (two-horse / three-horse) rank to increase cavalry without raising Zat; (3) Shah Jahan introduced the 'Month-Scale' (Mahwar) system; (4) Mansabdars paid in cash were called 'Naqdi' and those paid via land assignments were 'Jagirdars' (non-hereditary).
qe: In Emperor Akbar's 'Mansabdari' system, what did the two numerical ranks 'Zat' and 'Sawar' respectively indicate?
oe: Personal status/salary of the noble and the number of cavalrymen he had to maintain
Area of Jagir land and annual cash tax
Number of elephants and number of infantry soldiers
Judicial rank and provincial revenue rank

q: छत्रपति शिवाजी के 'अष्टप्रधान' मंत्रिपरिषद में 'अमात्य' (मजूमदार) और 'सुमंत' (दबीर) के विभाग क्रमशः क्या थे?
e: In Shivaji's Ashtapradhan: Amatya (Majumdar) was the Finance/Revenue Minister, and Sumant (Dabir) was the Foreign Affairs Minister. (अष्टप्रधान में अमात्य (मजूमदार) वित्त मंत्री तथा सुमंत (दबीर) विदेश मंत्री होते थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) All 8 ministers of Ashtapradhan: Peshwa (PM), Amatya (Finance), Waqia-Navis/Mantri (Home/Intelligence), Sachiv/Shuru-Navis (Royal Correspondence), Sumant (Foreign Affairs), Sar-i-Naubat/Senapati (Military), Pandit Rao (Religious/Charity), Nyayadhish (Chief Justice); (2) Except Pandit Rao and Nyayadhish, all 6 ministers held military commands; (3) None of the Ashtapradhan posts were hereditary under Shivaji.
qe: In Chhatrapati Shivaji's Council of Eight Ministers ('Ashtapradhan'), what was the portfolio of the 'Amatya' (Majumdar) and 'Sumant' (Dabir) respectively?

q: शिवाजी के अधीन मराठा राजस्व प्रशासन में पड़ोसी क्षेत्रों से वसूले जाने वाले 'चौथ' और 'सरदेशमुखी' करों की दरें क्रमशः कितनी थीं?
e: 'Chauth' was 1/4th (25%) of the assessed land revenue paid by neighbouring non-Maratha territories in return for protection from Maratha raids, while 'Sardeshmukhi' was an additional 1/10th (10%) claimed by Shivaji as the hereditary chief headman (Sardeshmukh) of Maharashtra. ('चौथ' 1/4 भाग (25%) तथा 'सरदेशमुखी' 1/10 भाग (10%) था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Within his own Swarajya territory, Shivaji used Annaji Datto's Kathi land survey (1679) and collected 33% (later 40%) land revenue; (2) Regular cavalry directly maintained by the state were 'Bargirs', while mercenary cavalry bringing their own horses were 'Silahdars'.
qe: In Maratha revenue administration under Shivaji, what were the exact rates of 'Chauth' and 'Sardeshmukhi' levied on neighbouring territories?

q: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के लिए व्यापारिक विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त करने हेतु कौन-से ब्रिटिश राजदूत मुगल सम्राट जहाँगीर के दरबार में आए थे?
o: कैप्टन विलियम हॉकिन्स और सर थॉमस रो
e: Captain William Hawkins (1608–11, honoured with 'English Khan' and 400 Mansab) and Sir Thomas Roe (1615–19, ambassador of King James I) visited Jahangir's court at Agra and Ajmer. (कैप्टन विलियम हॉकिन्स (1608) और सर थॉमस रो (1615) जहाँगीर के दरबार में आए थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Jahangir installed the 'Chain of Justice' (ज़ंजीर-ए-अदली) with 60 bells at Agra Fort; (2) The 'Nur Jahan Junta' (Nur Jahan, Itmad-ud-Daulah, Asaf Khan, Prince Khurram) wielded major political influence; (3) Bernier and Tavernier visited during Shah Jahan/Aurangzeb's era; (4) Ralph Fitch was the first Englishman to visit Akbar's court (1585).
qe: Which British diplomatic envoys visited Emperor Jahangir's court seeking trading privileges for the English East India Company?
oe: Captain William Hawkins and Sir Thomas Roe

q: किस मुगल सम्राट ने फतेहपुर सीकरी में 'अनुवाद विभाग' (मकतबखाना) की स्थापना की, जहाँ महाभारत का फारसी अनुवाद 'रज़्मनामा' नाम से किया गया?
e: Akbar established the Translation Bureau under Faizi, where Badauni, Naqib Khan, and Faizi translated the Mahabharata into Persian as 'Razmnama' (Book of Wars). (अकबर के अनुवाद विभाग में महाभारत का फारसी अनुवाद 'रज़्मनामा' नाम से किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Ramayana was translated into Persian by Abdul Qadir Badauni; (2) Lilavati (mathematics) was translated by Faizi; (3) Atharvaveda by Haji Ibrahim Sirhindi; (4) Panchatantra was translated as 'Anwar-i-Suhaili' (by Abul Fazl) and 'Yar-i-Danish'.
qe: Which Mughal Emperor established the 'Maktab Khana' (Translation Bureau) at Fatehpur Sikri, where the Mahabharata was translated into Persian as 'Razmnama'?

q: 1659 ई. में छत्रपति शिवाजी द्वारा 'बघनखे' से बीजापुर के सेनापति अफज़ल खाँ का वध किस दुर्ग के निकट हुआ था?
e: On 10 November 1659, Shivaji killed Bijapur general Afzal Khan in a famous personal encounter at the foot of Pratapgad Fort (Satara, Maharashtra). (10 नवंबर 1659 को प्रतापगढ़ दुर्ग की तलहटी में शिवाजी ने अफज़ल खाँ का वध किया था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) In 1663, Shivaji carried out a daring night raid on Mughal Governor Shaista Khan's camp at Lal Mahal, Pune; (2) Shivaji sacked the rich Mughal port of Surat twice (1664 and 1670); (3) In 1670, Tanaji Malusare heroically captured Kondana Fort (renamed Sinhagad).
qe: In 1659 CE, the killing of Bijapur general Afzal Khan by Chhatrapati Shivaji using 'Bagh Nakh' (tiger claws) took place near which fort?

q: मुगल प्रांतीय प्रशासन (जिसे अकबर ने 1580 में 12 सूबों में पुनर्गठित किया) में कौन-सा अधिकारी सूबेदार (गवर्नर) पर स्वतंत्र नियंत्रण रखते हुए प्रांतीय वित्त/राजस्व प्रमुख के रूप में कार्य करता था?
e: In each Mughal Suba (province), the 'Subedar' (Sipahsalar/Nazim) held executive/military authority while the 'Diwan' controlled revenue and finance directly under the central Diwan-i-Ala—creating a system of checks and balances. (प्रत्येक सूबे में सूबेदार कार्यकारी प्रमुख तथा दीवान स्वतंत्र वित्त प्रमुख होता था, जो परस्पर संतुलन बनाए रखते थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Suba → Sarkar (headed by Faujdar for law & order, Amalguzar for revenue) → Pargana (Shiqdar & Amil) → Village (Muqaddam & Patwari); (2) Akbar had 15 Subas by 1605 (adding Berar, Khandesh, Ahmednagar), while Aurangzeb had 20–21 Subas; (3) 'Mir Bakhshi' was the central military paymaster and head of intelligence (Waqia-Navis).
qe: In Mughal provincial administration (reorganized into 12 Subas by Akbar in 1580), which officer functioned as the provincial Finance/Revenue head acting as an independent check on the Subedar (Governor)?

q: कश्मीरी पंडितों की धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता की रक्षा करने के कारण किस सिख गुरु को 1675 ई. में औरंगजेब के आदेश पर दिल्ली में शहीद किया गया?
e: Ninth Sikh Guru, Guru Tegh Bahadur ('Hind di Chadar'), was executed at Chandni Chowk, Delhi (site of Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib) in November 1675 CE on Aurangzeb's orders. (नौवें सिख गुरु, गुरु तेग बहादुर ('हिन्द की चादर') को 1675 ई. में औरंगजेब के आदेश पर दिल्ली के चाँदनी चौक में शहीद किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Fifth Sikh Guru, Guru Arjan Dev (compiler of Adi Granth) was executed earlier in 1606 CE by Jahangir for blessing rebel Prince Khusrau; (2) Tenth Sikh Guru, Guru Gobind Singh founded the 'Khalsa Panth' on Baisakhi 1699 at Anandpur Sahib; (3) Sixth Guru Hargobind built the Akal Takht and wore two swords (Miri and Piri).
qe: Which Sikh Guru was executed in Delhi in 1675 CE on the orders of Emperor Aurangzeb for defending the religious freedom of Kashmiri Pandits?

q: जहाँगीर के शासनकाल में किस महान मुगल चित्रकार को पक्षियों व पशुओं (जैसे साइबेरियाई सारस) के अद्वितीय प्राकृतिक चित्रों के लिए 'नादिर-उल-अस्र' की उपाधि दी गई थी?
e: Ustad Mansur excelled in flora and fauna paintings and was awarded the title 'Nadir-ul-Asr' by Jahangir, whereas Abul Hasan (portraitist) received 'Nadir-uz-Zaman'. (उस्ताद मंसूर को 'नादिर-उल-अस्र' तथा अबुल हसन को 'नादिर-उज़-ज़माँ' की उपाधि जहाँगीर ने दी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bishandas was sent to Persia by Jahangir to paint Shah Abbas's portrait; (2) Daswant and Basawan were top painters in Akbar's court ('Hamzanama' & 'Razmnama' illustrations); (3) Mir Sayyid Ali and Abdus Samad were Persian masters brought to India by Humayun.
qe: During Jahangir's reign, which master Mughal painter received the title 'Nadir-ul-Asr' (Wonder of the Age) for his unmatched natural-history paintings of birds and animals (like the Siberian Crane and Dodo)?

q: उत्तर भारत में सम्राट औरंगजेब के विरुद्ध 1669 ई. में मथुरा के जाट विद्रोह का प्रथम नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Tilpat zamindar Gokula led the first organized Jat revolt in Mathura against Aurangzeb's revenue oppression and temple destruction in 1669 CE; later Rajaram (1685), Churaman, and Maharaja Suraj Mal (Bharatpur) carried forward Jat power. (1669 ई. में तिलपत के जमींदार गोकुला ने मथुरा में औरंगजेब के विरुद्ध प्रथम संगठित जाट विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Satnami Revolt broke out in Narnaul (Haryana) in 1672 CE; (2) Maharaja Suraj Mal is known as the 'Plato of the Jat Tribe'; (3) Bundela rebellion was led by Chhatrasal Bundela.
qe: Who was the main leader of the Satnami Revolt (1672 CE) and the Jat Revolt (1669 CE under Gokula) that challenged Emperor Aurangzeb in North India?

q:
सम्राट अकबर के शासनकाल की निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को सही कालानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
1. जज़िया कर की समाप्ति
2. दीन-ए-इलाही (तौहीद-ए-इलाही) की घोषणा
3. महज़रनामा की घोषणा
4. हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध
e: Exact chronology: Abolition of Jizya (1564 CE) → Battle of Haldighati (1576 CE) → Issue of Mahzar Nama (1579 CE, drafted by Shaikh Mubarak) → Promulgation of Din-i-Ilahi (1582 CE). Hence 1, 4, 3, 2. (कालानुक्रम: जज़िया समाप्ति (1564) → हल्दीघाटी (1576) → महज़रनामा (1579) → दीन-ए-इलाही (1582), अतः 1, 4, 3, 2।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Abolition of Slavery (1562) and Pilgrimage Tax (1563) preceded Jizya abolition (1564); (2) Ibadat Khana was built in 1575 and opened to all religions in 1578; (3) Ilahi Era (calendar) was started in 1583–84 CE.
qe:
Arrange the following events of Emperor Akbar's reign in correct chronological order:
1. Abolition of Jizya
2. Promulgation of Din-i-Ilahi (Tauhid-i-Ilahi)
3. Issue of the Mahzar (Infallibility Decree)
4. Battle of Haldighati

q:
सूची-I (मुगल ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ) को सूची-II (लेखक) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) अकबरनामा, (2) मुन्तखब-उत-तवारीख, (3) पादशाहनामा, (4) आलमगीरनामा
सूची-II: (a) अब्दुल हमीद लाहौरी, (b) मिर्ज़ा मुहम्मद काज़िम, (c) अबुल फज़ल, (d) अब्दुल कादिर बदायूनी
e: Akbarnama (3rd volume: Ain-i-Akbari) — Abul Fazl (1-c); Muntakhab-ut-Tawarikh (critical of Akbar) — Abdul Qadir Badauni (2-d); Padshahnama (Shah Jahan's official chronicle) — Abdul Hamid Lahori (3-a); Alamgirnama (first 10 years of Aurangzeb) — Mirza Muhammad Kazim (4-b). (अकबरनामा-अबुल फज़ल, मुन्तखब-बदायूनी, पादशाहनामा-लाहौरी, आलमगीरनामा-काज़िम; अतः 1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Khafi Khan wrote 'Muntakhab-ul-Lubab' (secret history of Aurangzeb); (2) Saqi Mustaid Khan wrote 'Maasir-i-Alamgiri'; (3) Nizamuddin Ahmad wrote 'Tabaqat-i-Akbari'.
qe:
Match List-I (Mughal Historical Work) with List-II (Author) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) Akbarnama, (2) Muntakhab-ut-Tawarikh, (3) Padshahnama, (4) Alamgirnama
List-II: (a) Abdul Hamid Lahori, (b) Mirza Muhammad Kazim, (c) Abul Fazl, (d) Abdul Qadir Badauni

q:
जून 1665 में छत्रपति शिवाजी और मिर्ज़ा राजा जयसिंह के बीच हुई पुरंदर की संधि के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: शिवाजी ने अपने 35 दुर्गों में से 23 दुर्ग मुगलों को सौंपना स्वीकार किया और 12 दुर्ग अपने पास रखे।
कथन II: शिवाजी के अल्पवयस्क पुत्र संभाजी को 5,000 का मुगल मनसब दिया गया, जबकि स्वयं शिवाजी को मुगल दरबार में व्यक्तिगत उपस्थिति से छूट दी गई।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are historically accurate terms of the Treaty of Purandar (11 June 1665). Italian traveller Niccolao Manucci was present in Jai Singh's camp during this treaty. (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं; पुरंदर की संधि (1665) में शिवाजी ने 23 किले मुगलों को दिए और संभाजी को 5,000 का मनसब मिला।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Following Jai Singh's persuasion, Shivaji visited Aurangzeb's court at Agra in May 1666, was placed under house arrest, and famously escaped in August 1666; (2) By 1670–74, Shivaji recaptured almost all the surrendered forts including Sinhagad and Purandar.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Treaty of Purandar (June 1665) signed between Chhatrapati Shivaji and Mirza Raja Jai Singh:
Statement I: Shivaji agreed to surrender 23 out of his 35 forts to the Mughals, retaining 12 forts.
Statement II: Shivaji's minor son Sambhaji was granted a Mughal Mansab of 5,000, while Shivaji himself was exempted from personal attendance at the Mughal court.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: शाहजहाँ के पुत्रों के बीच हुए मुगल उत्तराधिकार युद्ध (1658–59) की निम्नलिखित लड़ाइयों में से कौन-सी सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: बहादुरपुर का युद्ध — सुलेमान शिकोह ने शाह शुजा को हराया
धरमत का युद्ध — औरंगजेब व मुराद ने जसवंत सिंह को हराया
सामूगढ़ का युद्ध — औरंगजेब ने दारा शिकोह को निर्णायक रूप से हराया
देवराई का युद्ध — दारा शिकोह ने औरंगजेब को निर्णायक रूप से हराया
e: Statement D is incorrect: at the Battle of Deorai (near Ajmer, March 1659), AURANGZEB decisively defeated Dara Shikoh for the final time, after which Dara was captured and executed in August 1659. (कथन D गलत है; देवराई के अंतिम युद्ध (1659) में औरंगजेब ने दारा शिकोह को अंतिम रूप से पराजित किया था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) At the Battle of Khajwa (Jan 1659, Fatehpur district, UP), Aurangzeb defeated Shah Shuja; (2) Following Samugarh (May 1658), Aurangzeb imprisoned Shah Jahan in Agra Fort (where he lived until 1666); (3) Aurangzeb underwent two coronations (July 1658 and June 1659).
qe: Which of the following battles fought during the Mughal War of Succession (1658–59) among Shah Jahan's sons is NOT correctly matched with its combatants/outcome?
oe: Battle of Bahadurpur (Feb 1658) — Sulaiman Shikoh defeated Shah Shuja
Battle of Dharmat (April 1658) — Aurangzeb & Murad defeated Jaswant Singh
Battle of Samugarh (May 1658) — Aurangzeb decisively defeated Dara Shikoh
Battle of Deorai (March 1659) — Dara Shikoh decisively defeated Aurangzeb

q: अकबर के प्रारंभिक शासनकाल (1560–1562 ई.) में 'पर्दा शासन' (पेटीकोट सरकार) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: वकील के रूप में बैरम खाँ का शासन
बैरम खाँ के पतन के बाद माहम अनगा, अधम खाँ और उनके गुट का राजनीतिक प्रभाव
आगरा पर नूरजहाँ का संरक्षण शासन
फतेहपुर सीकरी में राजपूत रानियों का प्रशासन
e: Between Bairam Khan's dismissal (1560) and Adham Khan's execution (1562), Akbar's foster-mother Maham Anaga, her son Adham Khan, and Shihabuddin Ahmad Khan exercised strong court influence—termed the 'Parda Regime' by historians like V.A. Smith. (1560 से 1562 ई. के बीच अकबर की धाय माँ माहम अनगा और उनके पुत्र अधम खाँ के प्रभावकाल को इतिहासकारों ने 'पर्दा शासन' कहा है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bairam Khan served as Akbar's regent (Wakil-i-Saltanat) from 1556 to 1560 (winning the Second Battle of Panipat, 5 Nov 1556 against Hemu); (2) After 1562, Akbar asserted complete personal authority, marrying Harkha Bai (Amer) and abolishing slavery (1562) and pilgrimage tax (1563).
qe: What was the 'Petticoat Government' (Parda Regime, 1560–1562 CE) during the early reign of Akbar?
oe: Rule of Bairam Khan as Wakil
Political influence of Maham Anaga, Adham Khan, and her faction after Bairam Khan's fall
Regency of Nur Jahan over Agra
Administration of Rajput princesses at Fatehpur Sikri

q: मुगल स्मारकों और उनके निर्माताओं का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: हुमायूँ का मकबरा (दिल्ली) — हाजी बेगम (बेगा बेगम)
e: Moti Masjid inside AGRA FORT was built by SHAH JAHAN (not Aurangzeb), whereas Moti Masjid inside DELHI'S RED FORT was built by Aurangzeb! This distinction is a favourite UP TGT/PGT trap. (आगरा किले की मोती मस्जिद शाहजहाँ ने बनवाई थी, जबकि दिल्ली के लाल किले की मोती मस्जिद औरंगजेब ने बनवाई थी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Tomb of Itmad-ud-Daulah (built by Nur Jahan for her father Mirza Ghiyas Beg, 1622–28) is the first Mughal monument built entirely of white marble with Pietra Dura; (2) Humayun's Tomb (architect: Mirak Mirza Ghiyas) is the prototype of the Taj Mahal (Charbagh + Double Dome); (3) Akbar's Tomb at Sikandra (Agra) was begun by Akbar and completed by Jahangir.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Mughal monuments and their builders is NOT correctly matched?

q: अकबर की प्रशासनिक शब्दावली में 'मदद-ए-माश' (या सयूरगल) क्या था?
o: विद्वानों, संतों और धार्मिक व्यक्तियों को दी जाने वाली कर-मुक्त भूमि अनुदान
युद्ध के समय वसूला जाने वाला आपातकालीन सैन्य कर
ग्रामीणों से लिया जाने वाला बेगार श्रम
सूरत बंदरगाह पर वसूला जाने वाला सीमा शुल्क
e: 'Madad-i-Maash' (or Suyurghal) were tax-free subsistence land grants administered by the 'Sadr-us-Sudur' for supporting scholars, poets, Sufi saints, and charitable institutions. ('मदद-ए-माश' विद्वानों, संतों व धार्मिक संस्थाओं को सद्र-उस-सुदूर के माध्यम से दी जाने वाली कर-मुक्त भूमि थी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) 'Khalisa' was crown land whose revenue went directly to the imperial treasury; (2) 'Jagir' was land assigned to Mansabdars in lieu of cash salary; (3) 'Watan Jagir' was hereditary ancestral territory granted to Rajput rulers (like Amer, Marwar) who entered Mughal service.
qe: In Akbar's administrative terminology, what was 'Madad-i-Maash' (or Suyurghal)?
oe: Tax-free land grants given to scholars, saints, and religious figures
Emergency military tax collected during war
Customs duty levied at Surat port

q: छत्रपति शिवाजी (जिन्हें "भारतीय नौसेना का जनक" भी कहा जाता है) द्वारा स्थापित मराठा नौसेना के प्रमुख तटीय दुर्गों में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रमुख समुद्री किला था?
e: Shivaji built a strong Konkan navy (initially under Darya Sarang and Maynak Bhandari; later famously led by Kanhoji Angre) anchored at formidable island/coastal forts like Sindhudurg (Malvan), Vijaydurg, and Suvarnadurg to counter Portuguese, English, and Siddi naval power. (शिवाजी ने कोंकण तट पर सिंधुदुर्ग और विजयदुर्ग जैसे अजेय समुद्री किले बनवाकर शक्तिशाली मराठा नौसेना की नींव रखी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Shivaji's navy used agile vessels like Gurabs and Galbats; (2) On Navy Day (4 December 2023), the Indian Navy unveiled new admirals' epaulettes inspired by Chhatrapati Shivaji's octagonal Rajmudra; (3) Kanhoji Angre (Sarkhel) remained undefeated against European navies in the early 18th century.
qe: Which Maratha naval chief under Chhatrapati Shivaji (and later the Marathas) is celebrated for building a formidable Konkan coastal navy, with Shivaji himself known as the "Father of the Indian Navy"?
